title: dynamicVariantRecalculationResponse
description: Response returned when recalculation is triggered. Contains one job per unique root product resolved from the submitted IDs, plus any IDs that were skipped (for example, because a job for that root is already PENDING or PROCESSING).

jobs.description: List of recalculation jobs created or referenced for each unique root product.

skippedProductIds.description: Product IDs that were not processed because a recalculation job for their root is already active (PENDING or PROCESSING). The existing job ID is available in the `jobs` list.

dynamicVariantRecalculationJobResponse.description: Represents a single dynamic variant recalculation job. One job is created per unique root product. Jobs remain queryable until automatically removed approximately 30 days after reaching a terminal state.

id.description: Unique identifier of the recalculation job.

parentRoot.description: Identifier of the root product whose variant tree is being recalculated.

requestedByIds.description: List of product IDs that were submitted in the recalculation request and resolved to this root.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the job was created.

processingStartedAt.description: Timestamp when a subscriber picked up the job and started processing. Null while the job is still PENDING.

finishedAt.description: Timestamp when the job reached a terminal state (FINISHED, FAILED, or FAILED_PERMANENT).

error.description: Error message if the job failed. Null for successful jobs.

attempts.description: Number of processing attempts made for this job. Incremented on each delivery from the pub/sub subscription.

dynamicVariantRecalculationJobStatus.description: Current status of a dynamic variant recalculation job.
